summary: Answered the owner's 'gaining traction' note: ranked the niche's last 14 days of Shorts by subject and added 4 topics whose reference videos are rising right now (maglev, first bicycle, Faraday's generator, the phone-microphone study), plus a proposal to rank the feed by traction.
why: Owner note 19 Nov. In the 18 Nov scan, invention Shorts run 2.54x their channel's median this fortnight, trains 2.40x, phones 1.84x, rockets 0.90x.

findings.title: Inventions and trains are rising; rockets are not
findings.detail: Last-14-day Shorts vs their channel's median: invention 2.54x, trains 2.40x, phones 1.84x, planes 1.77x, AI 1.12x, rockets 0.90x.

findings.title: Logibu's maglev Short: 1.45M in 6 days on a 36K channel
findings.detail: Its numbered invention series opens every part at 100K+ views a day.

findings.title: Phone-listening Short: 2.45M in 7 days
findings.detail: Told tonight from the Northeastern study of 17,260 Android apps (no app switched on the mic; some sent screenshots).

findings.title: Length makes no difference in this niche
findings.detail: Every length band from 0-20 s to 90 s+ sits at 0.94-1.05x the channel median.

changes.title: 4 topics added to the feed
changes.detail: maglev (9.06), first bicycle (7.66), Faraday's generator (7.45), phone-mic study (7.29); 3 of 4 core, all global, each with views a day of its reference.

changes.title: Proposal tech-topic-traction-score (adopt, for the improver)
changes.detail: A capped traction bonus in generator/topics.py from the reference's views a day.
